theme: FLAGMAP + NTHPOS route/hop registry (kv flags + positional hop peel)
prior_note: iter 160 RESTARGS count gates; this iter first realworld FLAGMAP/NTHPOS (987-988)

tests.name: gate_soft
tests.cmd: gate src+dst+hops; soft NTHPOS OOR EXIT 2

weaknesses.title: CUBALC_ARG0 env no longer reaches SYS ARG in 1.15.426
weaknesses.detail: export CUBALC_ARG0=open leaves SYS ARG 0 and SYS ENV CUBALC_ARG0 empty; python sees the env var. Positional `cubalc run file open s0` works. Breaks all prior host contracts that used CUBALC_ARG* alone.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_ARG0=open cubalc run prog; SYS ARG 0 → empty; cubalc run prog open works

weaknesses.title: DEFAULT still requires = (optional = is LET-only)
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT ACTION "list" → err DEFAULT name = value. Optional glue from 974 is LET/IF only, not DEFAULT. Agents must keep DEFAULT name = val.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT ACTION "list" hard-fail

weaknesses.title: LET x LAST without = may not bind LAST token
weaknesses.detail: Prefer LET x = LAST for special knobs. Documented during ARG parse debug; optional LET is for literals/vars not always LAST.
weaknesses.repro: LET ACTION LAST vs LET ACTION = LAST

weaknesses.title: PRINT multi-arg overwrites LAST with joined line
weaknesses.detail: Agents that PRINT then read LAST for prior ARG lose the arg. Capture before SAY.
weaknesses.repro: SYS ARG 0; PRINT "x"; LAST is x not arg

weaknesses.title: WRITE VAL omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: od -c META ends without \n.
weaknesses.repro: od -c META.txt

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE=abc softens
weaknesses.detail: Non-numeric REQUIRE miss exit 0.
weaknesses.repro: REQUIRE=abc MINLOG=99 gate soft

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE ARGC hard-fail leaves process exit_code 0
weaknesses.detail: REQUIRE ARGC N when short sets ok:false + asserts_fail and sticky err, but plate exit_code stays 0 and shell 0 is 0. Agents cannot rely on process status for CLI contract failures; only EXIT n propagates shell rc.
weaknesses.repro: cubalc run -e 'SYS ENV SET CUBALC_ARGC 0; REQUIRE ARGC 1' → exit_code 0 shell 0

weaknesses.title: SYS ARGS LAST_N is not field count
weaknesses.detail: After SYS ARGS, LAST is the bag string and LAST_N is often 1 (non-empty), not ARGC. Must SYS LINES bag or use SYS ARGC separately for path counts.
weaknesses.repro: SYS ARGS; PRINT LAST_N  # not always == ARGC

weaknesses.title: export CUBALC_ARG* still dead; only SYS ENV SET or positional works
weaknesses.detail: Reconfirmed W1: export CUBALC_ARG0=argc CUBALC_ARGC=1 before cubalc run leaves ARGC=0 and defaults ACTION=list. In-process SYS ENV SET CUBALC_ARG* works (proof 976). Host env contract remains broken for outer shells.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_ARG0=argc cubalc run seal_batch… → list/argc0

weaknesses.title: WRITE multi-line bag often omits final NL on last field
weaknesses.detail: cat -A PATHS.txt shows intermediate lines with $ but last path without trailing newline. Same class as W5 single-line VAL omit NL.
weaknesses.repro: args p1 p2 p3; cat -A PATHS.txt

weaknesses.title: cubalc run strips unknown long options unless after host --
weaknesses.detail: Program args like --mode=seal never reach SYS ARG/HASFLAG unless invoked as: cubalc run prog ACTION -- --mode=seal files. Without the host double-dash separator, agents silently lose all long options.
weaknesses.repro: cubalc run prog parse --mode=seal a (MODE default); cubalc run prog parse -- --mode=seal a (works)

weaknesses.title: bare bool GETFLAG/HASFLAG consumes next positional as value
weaknesses.detail: Bare --verbose before a.bin makes verbose=a.bin and RESTARGS only keeps later files. Prefer --verbose=1 or --verbose -- then files.
weaknesses.repro: RESTARGS after --verbose file loses file as flag value

weaknesses.title: HASFLAG/GETFLAG/HASARG reject variable tokens (literals only)
weaknesses.detail: HASFLAG NAME with NAME=mode yields 0 even when --mode present; HASFLAG mode yields 1. Same for HASARG idx vs HASARG 0. Agents must EQS-branch known names/indices.
weaknesses.repro: LET n mode; HASFLAG n -> 0; HASFLAG mode -> 1

weaknesses.title: HASARGC min wants literal; variable MIN unreliable
weaknesses.detail: Board branches literal mins 1/2/3/4/9 and falls back to SYS ARGC compare for other values.
weaknesses.repro: LET m 2; HASARGC m vs HASARGC 2

weaknesses.title: host strips positional token run from program args
weaknesses.detail: cubalc run prog.cubalc run -- --mode=x leaves ARG0 as --mode=x (token run dropped). Other action names (deploy, dry, list) pass through. Action cannot be named run; use deploy/apply or CUBALC_*_ACTION env.
weaknesses.repro: cubalc run -e 'SYS ARG 0; PRINT LAST' run -- --mode=x → prints --mode=x

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE FLAG miss leaves process exit_code 0
weaknesses.detail: Same class as REQUIRE ARGC (W7): ok:false + asserts_fail + sticky err with usage tip, but shell $? is 0. Agents must EXIT n after soft probe for shell-visible contract failures.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_DC_REQUIRE=1 contract without flags → exit_code 0 shell 0

weaknesses.title: USAGE works; multi-part join and sticky tip on REQUIRE FLAG confirmed
weaknesses.detail: Positive note: sticky USAGE appends to REQUIRE FLAG err as · usage: …. Unicode ellipsis in USAGE string can mangle plate bytes — prefer ASCII ....
weaknesses.repro: USAGE line with unicode ellipsis → cat -A shows M-bM-^@M-&

weaknesses.title: SYS NUM can accept non-numeric ARG1 tokens in gate MIN override paths
weaknesses.detail: When ARG1 is a --flag form after host eats bare --, gate must not treat it as MIN. Guard with SYS STARTS ARG1 dash before NUM.
weaknesses.repro: gate -- --mode=x f1 without dash guard may corrupt MIN

weaknesses.title: HASRESTARGS/REQUIRE RESTARGS count action + numeric ARG tokens as files
weaknesses.detail: RESTARGS is all non-flag positionals. With ARG0=hasrest ARG1=2, raw rest_n=2 and HASRESTARGS 2 passes with zero files. Agents must DROP action (and non-path args) before file gates; raw REQUIRE RESTARGS is a false friend for file intake.
weaknesses.repro: hasrest 2 (no files) → HASRESTARGS 2 hit; peeled file_n may be 1 (the 2)

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE RESTARGS min can pass on action-only CLIs
weaknesses.detail: admit -- --job=x with no files: peeled empty, but raw RESTARGS often includes action token so REQUIRE RESTARGS 1 succeeds. Honest file walls need peeled LINES + EXIT n, not bare REQUIRE RESTARGS.
weaknesses.repro: require 2 -- --job=x with REQUIRE_HIT may not hard-fail if raw count inflated

weaknesses.title: LISTFLAGS returns names only (no values) — good inventory, not config
weaknesses.detail: LISTFLAGS bag is mode/verbose/job without values. Pair with GETFLAG for values. Files never listed. Confirmed useful for flag inventory plates.
weaknesses.repro: LISTFLAGS with --job=ingest --verbose=1 a.bin → job\nverbose

weaknesses.title: HASRESTARGS min wants literal (same class as HASARGC/HASFLAG)
weaknesses.detail: Board branches HASRESTARGS 1/2/3/4; variable MIN unreliable for the form itself.
weaknesses.repro: LET m 2; HASRESTARGS m vs HASRESTARGS 2

weaknesses.title: NTHPOS 0 is the action token when action is positional ARG0
weaknesses.detail: With register -- --src=x hopA, NTHPOS 0=register and NTHPOS 1=hopA. Agents must peel action or use NTHPOS 1 for first hop. Same class as RESTARGS inflation (W19).
weaknesses.repro: nth 0 with hops → val is action name not first hop

weaknesses.title: Bare > in CAT/strings is a comparison/parse hazard
weaknesses.detail: Route rows use => not bare >. Prefer multi-char separators in bag keys to avoid operator collision.
weaknesses.repro: SYS CAT SRC ">" may parse as comparison in some contexts

weaknesses.title: Post-action k = k + LAST_N unknown-action tally can spuriously fail
weaknesses.detail: After a heavy register path (FLAGMAP+EACH+PUSH), classic LET k = LAST_N; LET k = k + LAST_N dispatch tally returned k=0 despite SYS EQS ACTION hit. Workaround: LET known=1 inside each action body.
weaknesses.repro: register succeeds then FAIL unknown action with k-sum pattern

weaknesses.title: FLAGMAP bare --flag value is 1 and does not consume following hops
weaknesses.detail: Positive: --verbose hopA leaves hopA in RESTARGS; FLAGMAP verbose=1. Prefer --name=val for non-bools. LOOKUP fmap key = works.
weaknesses.repro: FLAGMAP with --verbose hopA → verbose=1; hops keep hopA

workarounds: NTHPOS 1 for first hop when ARG0 is action; or DROP action from RESTARGS
FLAGMAP + SYS LOOKUP bag key = for --src/--dst
Latch known=1 per action instead of end k-sum EQS tally
Route sep => not bare >; --flag=val for non-bools
Reuse established bag vars (meta) for final report PUSH
